subject.title: Add package changelog previews for plugin publishing

question: Should package changelog previews permit direct owners, publisher-organization owners/admins/publishers, moderators, and admins to read prior package release content for generation?
rationale: Tests prove the proposed roles and ordering, but repository history and CI cannot establish whether this is the intended permanent trust boundary.

options.title: Approve and document the boundary
options.body: Keep the implemented role set and add durable `specs/` language requiring authorization before any prior-release storage read.

options.title: Narrow privileged access
options.body: Restrict previews to package publishing principals and exclude platform moderator or admin access unless separately justified.

options.title: Pause package previews
options.body: Do not land the feature until a different history-access design is selected.

recommendation.title: Approve and document the boundary
recommendation.body: Keep the implemented role set and add durable `specs/` language requiring authorization before any prior-release storage read.

likelyOwner.reason: They most recently owned the merged plugin publish-flow behavior and tests on current main.
